mapper.select: select pci.ptitle_ko, pci.ptitle_ja, pci.ptitle_en, pci.ptitle_zh, pci.pno, pci.ciqty, pci.price, pci.pfilename, pci.cino from tbl_cart c left join ( select p.pno, ptitle_ko, p.ptitle_en, p.ptitle_ja, p.ptitle_zh, p.pfilename, p.price, ci.ciqty, ci.cno, ci.ciregdate, ci.cino from tbl_product p left join tbl_cartitem ci on p.pno = ci.pno ) pci on c.cno = pci.cno where c.cno = #{cno} order by pci.ciregdate desc limit #{pageRequest.skip}, #{pageRequest.size}
select count(ci.cino) from tbl_cart c left join tbl_cartitem ci on c.cno = ci.cno where c.cno = #{cno}
